Five ways in

Open

First come, first served until full.

Lottery

Apply in the window. Early doesn’t help.

Time qualifier

A fast time, inside that edition’s window.

Charity

Guaranteed entry for a fundraising pledge.

Membership

Club or prior-year races, like NYRR’s 9+1.
